lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Am I talking to Mrs. Kavita Iyer?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Madam this is the cyber crime cell. During a raid we seized 240 debit cards and one bank account was opened with your Aadhaar.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Over two crore rupees of illegal money passed through that account. A case has been registered against you.

lines.speaker: user
lines.text: Oh god, what do I do?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Join a video call on Skype now. You will remain on camera and you cannot talk to any other person until the inquiry is finished.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: If you do not cooperate, a non bailable warrant goes out today and police will come to your house.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: To show your money is clean, send whatever is in your savings to the RBI supervision account. It will be refunded after verification.
